'''Eventide''' was an [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] holiday celebrated on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] in which the normal order of life was changed so that most activity took place at night. Eventide lasted a little over three [[Standard month/Legends|standard months]].<ref name="Mask of the Pirate Queen" />
